title: SCAMP: Sparse-anchor Control is One Small Projection
abstract: arXiv:2605.14716v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Authoring with a text-to-motion generator needs sparse anchors: chosen joints, at chosen frames, at given positions. Meeting them currently costs   a conditioning branch trained for the task, or hundreds of per-clip optimisation steps in the architecture's native variables. In any generator   that decodes a continuous state through a frozen differentiable decoder, the anchors ask for little and leave most of the state free: a few   hundred numbers against a state of tens of thousands. Every control method is a choice among the states that satisfy them, and the choices differ   along the directions the anchors cannot see and the motion can. SCAMP makes the choice that moves none of them: damped Gauss-Newton in the space   of the anchors, through the frozen decoder alone, training-free, with one dimensionless damping constant. Every increment is a combination of   the rows of the anchors' Jacobian, so the correction is orthogonal

translated_title: SCAMP：稀疏锚点控制只需一次小投影
translated_abstract: 使用文本到动作生成器进行创作需要稀疏锚点：即在选定的帧上为选定的关节指定给定的位置。目前满足这些锚点的代价是，要么需要为该任务训练一个条件分支，要么需要在架构的原生变量中进行数百次逐片段优化。在任何通过冻结的可微分解码器解码连续状态的生成器中，锚点所需甚少，且使状态的大部分保持自由：相对于数万个状态变量，锚点仅涉及几百个数字。每种控制方法都是在满足锚点的状态中做出选择，而这些选择沿着锚点无法感知、但动作可以感知的方向有所不同。SCAMP 做出了不移动任何锚点的选择：在锚点空间中使用阻尼高斯-牛顿法，仅通过冻结的解码器进行，无需训练，且只需一个无量纲阻尼常数。每个增量都是锚点雅可比矩阵各行的组合，因此修正量是正交的。
tldr: SCAMP 提出了一种无需训练的文本到动作稀疏锚点控制方法，仅通过冻结解码器在锚点空间执行一次阻尼高斯-牛顿小投影，即可在满足稀疏锚点约束的同时保持其余动作状态不变。
